# openrouter_private_provider (Resource)

A private provider: your own inference provider, visible only to your organization. Its `name` shows in your activity, logs and Broadcast output. Use its `slug` as `provider_slug` on `openrouter_byok_key` and `openrouter_private_endpoint`; private endpoints under it use its `base_url` unless they set their own.

Changing `name` destroys the provider and creates a new one with a new `slug`. The API refuses to delete a provider while any private endpoint still runs under it, so destroy those first (Terraform does this when the endpoints reference `slug`).

`data_policy` is your own declaration for your own traffic; OpenRouter does not verify it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openrouter_private_provider" "my_privateprovider" {
  base_url = "https://inference.example.com/v1"
  data_policy = {
    prompt_retention_days = 30
    retains_prompts       = true
    training              = false
  }
  datacenters = [
    "US",
  ]
  display_name       = "WCIE"
  headquarters       = "US"
  name               = "WCIE"
  privacy_policy_url = "https://example.com/privacy"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_url` (String) HTTPS base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API. Private endpoints under this provider use it unless they set their own. Private, internal, metadata and OpenRouter hosts are rejected.
- `data_policy` (Attributes) Your own declaration of how the provider handles data. It applies to your own traffic; OpenRouter does not verify it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_policy))
- `display_name` (String)
- `name` (String) Provider name, shown in your activity, logs and Broadcast output. 2-64 letters, numbers, spaces, dots, underscores or hyphens. Cannot be changed later. Neither the name nor its slug may match an existing provider name or slug (case-insensitive). Requires replacement if changed.

### Optional

- `datacenters` (List of String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes of the datacenters serving requests.
- `headquarters` (String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
- `privacy_policy_url` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `slug` (String) Derived from the name: lowercased, with every run of other characters replaced by a hyphen (`Acme Inference` becomes `acme-inference`). Use it as `provider_slug` when creating private endpoints and BYOK keys.

<a id="nestedatt--data_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data_policy`

Required:

- `retains_prompts` (Boolean) Whether the provider retains prompts or completions.
- `training` (Boolean) Whether the provider trains on prompts.

Optional:

- `prompt_retention_days` (Number) Days prompts are retained. Must be `null` unless `retains_prompts` is true.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = openrouter_private_provider.my_openrouter_private_provider
  id = "wcie"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import openrouter_private_provider.my_openrouter_private_provider "wcie"
```
